title: Chapter 15
content_zh: Zhu Bajie, once the Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy, had been banished to earth for flirting with the moon goddess Chang'e. Reborn as a pig-monster, he joined Tripitaka's journey as the second disciple. He was lazy, gluttonous, and lecherous — but his strength with the nine-toothed rake was immense, and his loyalty, when it mattered, was absolute.
